description: This file is a shell script used for testing diff operations involving symlinks and files within a Git repository. It defines functions and test cases to verify diff behavior for different scenarios of symlinks and file modifications.

methods.name: symlink_oid
methods.description: Prints the short OID of the contents of a symlink, calculated via its hash-object and rev-parse commands.

methods.name: short_oid
methods.description: Prints the short OID of a given file by hashing its contents and parsing the short hash.
